{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df[df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999])}')
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
print(f'Number of unique patient_id values before deduplication: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of unique patients
num_patients = len(df)
print(f'Final number of unique patients: {num_patients}')"}
